subject: How to obtain the standardized solution for posterior SD in blavaan

messages.author: a5979a5752c669c8
messages.subject: How to obtain the standardized solution for posterior SD in blavaan
parts:
Hi,
     How to obtain the standardized solution for posterior SD in blavaan? In lavaan, standardizedSolution(fit) will produce the standardized solution for "se", but it only provides standardized parameter estimates for blavaan. I need to get the  standardized version of posterior SD in order to be comparable to MLE results.
    If no, could you kindly advice the formula for transforming from original posterior SD to its standardized version (Mplus Bayes estimator can produce standardized post.SD)? Thanks!

Menglin

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: How to obtain the standardized solution for posterior SD in blavaan
parts:
Menglin,

If fit is your blavaan object, try

pt <- parTable(fit)

standardizedSolution(fit, se=pt$se[pt$free > 0])

Ed
